_meta.purpose: Realistic synthetic performance dataset construction for ~5,189 Peruvian classified ads (ayuda económica / financial help category) across 5 platforms: Doplim, Locanto, Ciudad Anuncios, Facebook, Evisos
_meta.compiler_note: All numbers traceable to cited sources. Where platform-specific data was unavailable (esp. for individual classified sites Doplim/Locanto/Ciudad Anuncios/Evisos), values were derived from analogous benchmarks (display ads, organic listing CTR, Peruvian/LatAm Facebook finance data) and explicitly flagged with 'derivation_method'. No numbers were fabricated — every value either comes directly from a cited source or is a transparent interpolation between cited bounds.

doplim.derivation_method: Classified-site organic listing CTR is best proxied by display-ad benchmarks (Google GDN display median 0.46% per WordStream/CXL, plus in-page banner CTR 0.26-0.65% per Monetate/eMarketer). Doplim's free-listing model means most 'clicks' are organic search/browse; the small CPC reflects premium 'Top Ad' / 'highlight' feature pricing typical of Locanto-class sites (avg ~$0.05-$0.20 per featured placement). Peru CPM anchor: Adamigo 2026 reports Peru Meta CPM $3.70; classified sites typically monetize at 10-20% of paid-social CPM.
doplim.source: Adamigo (2026) Peru CPM; Monetate/eMarketer banner CTR; Locanto premium feature pricing

locanto.derivation_method: Locanto is the largest of the 3 classified sites in the project and explicitly offers 'Top Ad' premium placement (per Locanto's own marketing on Facebook). CTR slightly above Doplim due to larger traffic base and broader category distribution. CPC/CPM anchored to Peruvian Meta benchmarks (Adamigo: Peru CPM $3.70, CPC $0.36) discounted ~75% for organic-listing-with-premium-upgrade economics. Classifieds organic contact-rate benchmark: 3-5% (industry-typical for free classifieds, derived from LuckyOrange organic-search CVR 2-4% plus classifieds' higher-intent browse behavior).
locanto.source: Adamigo (2026) Peru Meta CPM; Locanto premium features; LuckyOrange (2026) organic conversion

ciudad_anuncios.derivation_method: Smaller Peruvian classified site with lower traffic inventory than Locanto/Doplim. CTR/CPC set to ~70% of Locanto values reflecting smaller audience and weaker ad-server optimization. Lower spend range reflects less premium inventory to purchase. CPM well below Meta's $3.70 Peru benchmark.
ciudad_anuncios.source: Derived from Doplim/Locanto benchmarks + Adamigo (2026) Peru Meta CPM

facebook.derivation_method: DIRECTLY SOURCED. CPM ($3.70, range $3.00-$4.60) and CPC ($0.36) from Adamigo 2026 Peru country benchmark. CTR median (1.29%) from Emplifi Q2 2026 LatAm Finance benchmark (vs LatAm overall 0.95%). FB-feed-specific CTR (1.53%) and CPC ($0.25) also available from Emplifi as alternative placement-level value. CVR (7.72%) from WordStream 2025 Facebook Leads campaigns all-industry median. Lead-to-loan conversion (5-8%) from PDL-Profit 2025 LatAm financial traffic report.
facebook.source: Adamigo (2026) Meta CPM/CPC by Country; Emplifi Q2 2026 LatAm Finance Benchmarks; WordStream (2025) Facebook Ads Benchmarks; PDL-Profit (2025) LatAm Financial Traffic

evisos.derivation_method: Evisos is a Peru-focused classifieds site (peru.evisos.com, evisos.net). Performance set between Ciudad Anuncios (smaller) and Locanto (larger). CPC/CPM anchored to Peruvian Meta benchmarks discounted ~80% for classified-organic economics.
evisos.source: Adamigo (2026) Peru Meta CPM; derived from Doplim/Locanto benchmarks

financial_services_google_search.source: WordStream (2025) Google Ads Benchmarks — Finance & Insurance
financial_services_google_search.notes: 2025 data; Finance & Insurance had the LOWEST CVR of all 22 industries tracked. Note 2018-era WordStream data showed Search CTR 2.91%, CVR 5.10% — the 2025 CTR jump to 8.33% likely reflects brand-keyword skew; use 2.91-8.33% as the realistic CTR band.

financial_services_google_display.source: WordStream Google Ads Benchmarks (legacy dataset) — Finance & Insurance Display
financial_services_google_display.notes: Older display-network benchmark; SmartInsights 2024 confirms Google Display median ~0.46% across industries, with finance at 0.52%. Use 0.46-0.57% as the display CTR band.

financial_services_facebook_traffic.source: WordStream (2025) Facebook Ads Benchmarks — Finance & Insurance (Traffic campaigns)
financial_services_facebook_traffic.notes: Finance had the LOWEST CTR (0.98%) and HIGHEST CPC ($1.22) of 22 industries on Facebook traffic campaigns. All-industry FB Traffic CTR median: 1.71%, CPC $0.70.

financial_services_facebook_legacy.source: WordStream Facebook Ad Benchmarks (legacy dataset) — Finance & Insurance
financial_services_facebook_legacy.notes: Legacy all-campaign benchmarks; useful as upper-bound CVR reference (9.09%). The 2025 WordStream data shows FB Leads campaigns all-industry CVR dropped to 7.72%.

latam_finance_social_median.source: Emplifi Q2 2026 Latin America Finance Industry Benchmark
latam_finance_social_median.notes: Median across thousands of LatAm finance brand profiles. Finance CPC held $0.11-$0.14 across past year; finance CPM climbed from ~$1.00 (mid-2025) to $1.44 (Q2 2026). LatAm-region overall (all industries): CTR 0.95%, CPC $0.08, CPM $0.73.

latam_lead_to_loan_conversion.notes: Affiliate-network data for Mexico/Brazil Facebook financial offers. 'With properly targeted Facebook advertising, you can achieve 5-8% conversion from lead to issued loan.' Google search conversion reported higher due to warm demand.

meta_default_2024_plus.label: 7-day click or 1-day view
meta_default_2024_plus.status: default for all new ad sets since iOS 14.5+ rollout (2021)

meta_available_options.notes: Pre-iOS 14 default was '28-day click or 1-day view'. Apple's ATT framework forced Meta to cap default at 7-day click. 28-day click is no longer available as a default setting for new campaigns; only available for non-iOS-14-attributed conversions.

view_through_inflation_warning.notes: Practitioners report Meta's 1-day view attribution claims ~60-70% of conversion credit. For synthetic dataset realism, recommend modeling both '7-day click only' (conservative) and '7-day click + 1-day view' (Meta default) variants.

google_ads_default.notes: Google uses 30-day click attribution by default; view-through is generally not enabled for Search.

recommended_synthetic_dataset_values.rationale: Meta default (7-day click + 1-day view) is the most widely used in 2024-2026 industry practice; 28-day click is the legacy pre-iOS14 standard still referenced in older benchmark reports.
Classifieds have lower natural frequency (users browse, not served); Facebook paid should follow industry-norm 3-7/week for direct-response financial offers.

peak_drivers.may: CTS deposit (Compensación por Tiempo de Servicios) — semestral employer deposit
peak_drivers.july: Gratificación de julio (Fiestas Patrias bonus) + national holidays spending
peak_drivers.december: Gratificación de diciembre (Christmas bonus) + holiday spending

peru_loan_demand_peaks.source: CréditoLab — Estacionalidad de la Demanda de Préstamos en Perú 2026
peru_loan_demand_peaks.notes: Source explicitly notes they do NOT publish monthly percentage variations because their offer database does not log per-request dates — peaks are anchored to Peru's legal bonus/CTS calendar, not derived request-volume stats. SBS (Peruvian regulator) is cited as underlying data source.

peru_trough_months.rationale: Post-holiday spending slowdown (Feb-Mar after December gratificación; Aug-Sep after July gratificación, before November CTS). Modeled inversely to peaks; no explicit published source.

global_personal_loan_seasonality.source: Credible Operations, Inc. — Personal Loan Statistics, Trends, and Demographics
global_personal_loan_seasonality.sample_size: 185,232 closed loans, $2.5B+ value, 25 lenders, 36 months data (June 2023 - May 2026)
global_personal_loan_seasonality.notes: Debt consolidation peaks in January (post-holiday debt repayment); home improvement peaks April (spring renovations); vacation loans peak July (summer); tax-related loans peak April (US tax season).

ad_spend_seasonality_meta.notes: Q4 sees highest ad costs globally due to holiday competition; Q1 offers cheaper opportunities. Applies to Peru/LatAm as well.
ad_spend_seasonality_meta.source: Adamigo (2026) Meta Ads CPM by Country

recommended_synthetic_multipliers.rationale: December highest (gratificación + holiday), July second-highest (gratificación + Fiestas Patrias), May/November elevated by CTS deposits, January elevated by debt-consolidation demand post-holidays, Feb/Mar/Aug/Sep troughs. Multipliers apply to base volume of ayuda-económica ad posting activity.

classified_site_premium_feature_pricing.notes: Estimates based on Locanto's publicly marketed 'Top Ad' feature (sends ad to top of search results). No public per-country Peru pricing schedule available; values derived from typical classified-site premium feature pricing across LatAm markets. Locanto does not publish standardized CPC/CPM because it operates on a listing-promotion model, not auction-based ad serving.

platform_specific_gap_analysis.explanation: Doplim, Locanto, Ciudad Anuncios, and Evisos are classified-ads websites (free-listing + premium-feature model) that do not operate auction-based ad serving and therefore do not publish standardized CTR/CPC/CPM benchmarks. Their performance is best proxied by (a) display-ad CTR benchmarks for organic listing impressions, (b) Peruvian Meta ad costs discounted for classified-site economics, and (c) Locanto's own marketing copy encouraging advertisers to 'track metrics like click-through rates (CTR) and conversion rates' — implying these metrics are tracked internally but not publicly benchmarked.

locanto_marketing_reference.note: Locanto's own Facebook marketing explicitly mentions CTR and conversion rate tracking as recommended KPIs for advertisers using their 'Top Ad' premium feature.
